# Measured results (generated by `scripts/summarize_results.py` from saved metrics files)

BMAD Brain (BraTS 2021 FLAIR, 240x240). Thresholds frozen on `valid` (83 images), test evaluated once per model. Research flags for qualified human review, not diagnosis.

Selected on validation only: **patchcore_s0** (rule: gates VRAM<=6 GB, latency<=1000 ms; within 0.02 AUPRO of best; then best mean rank of pixel AUROC, per-image Dice, image AUROC).

## Test split, all three models (3,715 images: 640 normal, 3,075 abnormal)

| Model | Image AUROC [95% patient-bootstrap CI] | Pixel AUROC (full frame) | Pixel AUROC (brain ROI) | AUPRO full / ROI | Dice per-image | Dice pooled | Latency ms | Ckpt MB |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| autoencoder_s0 | 0.254 [0.217, 0.290] | 0.854 | 0.497 | 0.592 / 0.210 | 0.207 | 0.180 | 0.7 | 5.3 |
| padim_s0 | 0.754 [0.713, 0.791] | 0.960 | 0.868 | 0.782 / 0.476 | 0.419 | 0.457 | 1.1 | 45.3 |
| patchcore_s0 | 0.909 [0.884, 0.931] | 0.979 | 0.922 | 0.847 / 0.583 | 0.501 | 0.600 | 4.5 | 37.0 |

Pixel metrics: the full-frame numbers include the easy black background; the brain-ROI numbers are the honest ones to quote for localisation.

## Image-level operating point at the validation-frozen threshold (test)

| Model | Threshold | Sensitivity | Specificity | FPR | Precision | F1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| autoencoder_s0 | 0.2379 | 0.996 | 0.000 | 1.000 | 0.827 | 0.904 |
| padim_s0 | 11.7201 | 0.546 | 0.777 | 0.223 | 0.922 | 0.686 |
| patchcore_s0 | 2.2374 | 0.789 | 0.878 | 0.122 | 0.969 | 0.869 |

Precision is high mainly because 83% of test images are abnormal; use sensitivity/specificity.

## Robustness variants (autoencoder_s0, test)

| Variant | n | Image AUROC | Pixel AUROC | AUPRO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| all images | 3715 | 0.254 | 0.854 | 0.592 |
| lesions <100 px removed | 3648 | n/a | 0.855 | 0.593 |
| patient-disjoint (drops 50 shared-patient images) | 3665 | 0.253 | 0.854 | 0.594 |
